instruction: The supplied receivables spreadsheet is open in LibreOffice Calc. Sort the entire table by outstanding_balance numerically descending, then invoice_id ascending for ties. Keep the header first and preserve every row and every other cell value. Export the sorted sheet as a UTF-8, comma-separated CSV to /tmp/ledgerdesk/exports/calc-sort-export.csv. Use the application's normal controls and confirm the CSV format if asked. Do not overwrite the source ODS.
environment: Linux X11 in Docker; 1200x900; no host mounts; desktop network internal
